finalText:
**Big but shallow.** `account_id` hits 1291 times in 94 files.

| Zone | Hits | Rename? |
|---|---|---|
| `services/**` JS vars | ~1079 | Yes |
| `repo/*.js` SQL strings | 125 | No |
| `migrations/` | 61 | No |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk/` | 20 | No |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | 5 | No |
| `lib/serialize.js` `WIRE` | 1 | No |

Four hard stops. The DB column stays, so SQL text stays. Applied migrations are history. Vendor code is generated and overwritten. The public field is frozen by contract.

`WIRE` in [lib/serialize.js:7](lib/serialize.js:7) is the seam. Left key must match the row column.

Next: sign off if the rename is JS identifiers only.
